description.zh: AgentID，经过CNNIC实名认证后，由CNNIC统一分配。AgentID作为Agent与实名认证注册人绑定的唯一标识
description.en: The agent ID that is assigned by CNNIC after real-name verification. The AgentID serves as the unique identifier that binds the agent to the real-name registered contact.

description.zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。

- 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样。
description.en:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a unique parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken value supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

- If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request.

description.zh: 查询的结束时间（时间戳）。
description.en: The end time of the query (timestamp).

description.zh: 操作日志记录的操作类型，比如修改Agent。
description.en: The operation type of the Operation logs log record, such as modifying an agent.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间（时间戳）。
description.en: The start time of the query (timestamp).
